findings.title: Large accepted page numbers overflow Int32 offset and repeat the first login-history page
findings.trigger: Authenticated me/login-history request with PageNumber=2147483647 and PageSize=100.

evidence.observation: Large positive page accepted; CalculateSkip multiplies Int32.
Shared offset arithmetic is identical; direct production uses not found.
Only positive page and size<=100 checks.
Current UserId filter and unchanged page values passed to repository/metadata.
Math.Max(0, overflowing product) changes -200 to Skip(0).
Authenticated bound query returns page result.

arithmetic_evidence.method: Node Math.imul signed-int32 model only; not C# or PostgreSQL execution

findings.impact: First page repeats with huge page metadata. Owner filter remains intact; no cross-account disclosure claimed. Admin UserRepository has related unchecked offset without Math.Max; provider-specific behavior not executed.
findings.recommendation: Add overflow-safe offset validation/calculation, reject or explicitly handle unrepresentable offsets, preserve ordinary paging and owner predicates.
required_regressions: Owner-scoped LoginHistory repository with multiple records and huge page must not repeat first page.
Boundary/normal pages, invalid-input status and cancellation; disposable Npgsql provider case.
findings.status: OPEN; static evidence, runtime regression pending T02/T13.
